description: This file defines a final class ImmutablePolicyBuilder that implements the PolicyBuilder interface. It provides a fluent API for constructing ImmutablePolicy objects, allowing setting of various policy attributes such as ID, lifecycle, revision, timestamps, subjects, resources, and permissions. The class includes methods for creating new instances, initializing from existing policies or entries, and building the final immutable policy object.

classes.name: ImmutablePolicyBuilder
classes.description: A builder class for constructing immutable Policy objects with flexible and fluent configuration options.
